title: ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: ProAS：一种面向多轮智能体强化学习的进度感知优势塑造框架

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the primary paradigm for optimizing Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet efficient critic-free algorithms (e.g., GRPO) suffer from a fundamental uniform credit assignment dilemma that broadcasts trajectory-level advantages equally to all actions. Our analysis reveals that this uniformity inherently reinforces structurally invalid actions in preferred trajectories and ignores the downstream cascading influence of early pivotal deviations in unpreferred ones. To resolve this without introducing critic overhead, we propose Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping (ProAS) , a plug-and-play framework that leverages a dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph (ARG) to achieve fine-grained credit assignment via Masking Unreasonable Incentives (MUI) and Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution (APR). Extensive experiments across Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate that ProAS universally elevates mainstream group-based baselines to new state-of-the-art performance, achieving peak success rates of 91.9% and 94.3% on ALFWorld, alongside 66.7% and 70.8% on WebShop, respectively. Furthermore, it accelerates training convergence by up to 2.44 × 2.44\times while maintaining strong robustness against imperfect or distilled ARGs. Codes: https://github.com/LINs-lab/ProAS .
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为优化大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的主要范式，但高效的无批评者算法（例如 GRPO）面临一个根本性的均匀信用分配困境：它将轨迹层面的优势平均分配给所有动作。 我们的分析表明，这种均匀性本质上会强化偏好轨迹中结构无效的动作，同时忽略非偏好轨迹中早期关键偏差所引发的后续连锁影响。 为了解决这一问题而无需引入批评者带来的额外开销，我们提出了“进展感知优势塑造”（Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping, ProAS）——一个即插即用的框架，通过动态演化的智能体参考图（Agentic Reference Graph, ARG），结合“屏蔽不合理激励”（Masking Unreasonable Incentives, MUI）和“非对称惩罚再分配”（Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution, APR），实现精细化的信用分配。 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上进行的广泛实验表明，ProAS 能够普遍将主流基于群体的基线模型提升至新的最优性能水平：在 ALFWorld 数据集上的最高成功率分别达到 91.9% 和 94.3%，在 WebShop 数据集上则分别为 66.7% 和 70.8%。 此外，该框架在保持对不完美的或经过蒸馏的 ARG 的强鲁棒性的同时，将训练收敛速度提升了高达 2.44 × 2.44\times。 代码：https://github.com/LINs-lab/ProAS .

paragraphs.en: Actor-critic algorithms (e.g., PPO ( ? )) address this by learning a separate critic, which introduces substantial computational overhead and optimization instability in long-horizon settings ( ?? ). Conversely, critic-free algorithms like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( ? ) offer computational efficiency by broadcasting a trajectory-level advantage uniformly to every action ( ? ). However, this inherently treats all intra-trajectory actions identically, completely overlooking their critical differences in local validity, task contribution, and downstream inflence. As detailed in § 3.2 , we term this structural limitation the uniform credit assignment dilemma .

paragraphs.en: To systematically understand the uniform credit assignment dilemma, we conduct a fine-grained action-intervention analysis (§ 4.2 ). Our findings reveal a dual suboptimality. First, in preferred trajectories with positive advantages, uniform credit inadvertently reinforces structurally invalid actions (i.e., unreasonable actions) that pollute the context history and impede the agent from reaching success. Second, in unpreferred trajectories with negative advantages, uniform penalization ignores the autoregressive nature of LLMs, where early deviations drive cascading failures; consequently, they unfairly suppress all actions equally without considering their actual downstream influence.
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统性地理解统一信用分配困境，我们进行了精细化的行动干预分析（§ 4.2）。 我们的研究结果揭示了一种双重次优性。 首先，在具有正优势值的优选轨迹中，统一信用分配会无意中强化结构上无效的行动（即不合理行动），这些行动会污染上下文历史，并阻碍智能体达成成功状态。 其次，在具有负优势值的非优选轨迹中，统一惩罚机制忽视了大语言模型的自回归特性——早期偏差会引发连锁故障；因此，这种机制未能考虑各行动的实际下游影响，而是对所有行动进行了不公平的均等压制。

sents.en: Second, in unpreferred trajectories with negative advantages, uniform penalization ignores the autoregressive nature of LLMs, where early deviations drive cascading failures; consequently, they unfairly suppress all actions equally without considering their actual downstream influence.

paragraphs.en: To resolve this dilemma without introducing critic overhead, we propose Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping (ProAS) in § 4.3 . ProAS leverages an Agentic Reference Graph (ARG, mentioned in § 4.1 ), which abstracts task progression into dynamically evolving sub-goals to formally annotate whether an action is reasonable (structurally valid) or progress-advancing (driving task completion). Using these structural annotations, ProAS asymmetrically reshapes trajectory-level advantages in Eq. 7 : (1) Masking Unreasonable Incentives (MUI) zeros out the local advantages of unreasonable actions in preferred trajectories to prevent their inadvertent reinforcement. (2) Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution (APR) utilizes Future-Drift (Eq. 6 ), the inclusive count of downstream non-advancing actions, to assign proportionally heavier penalties to actions triggering severe downstream stagnation.
paragraphs.zh: 为避免引入批评者带来的额外开销来解决这一困境，我们在 § 4.3 中提出了“进展感知优势塑造”（Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping，ProAS）。 ProAS 利用了一个智能体参考图（Agentic Reference Graph，ARG，见 § 4.1），该图将任务进展抽象为动态演变的子目标，从而正式标注某个动作是合理的（结构上有效的）还是推动进展的（促进任务完成的）。 借助这些结构标注，ProAS 对公式 7 中轨迹层面的优势进行了非对称重塑：(1) “屏蔽不合理激励”（Masking Unreasonable Incentives，MUI）将优选轨迹中不合理动作的局部优势置零，以防止这些动作被无意中强化。 (2) “非对称惩罚重分配”（Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution，APR）利用“未来漂移”（Future-Drift，公式 6）——即后续未推动进展的动作总数——对引发严重后续停滞的动作施加成比例更重的惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments in § 6 on ALFWorld ( ? ) and WebShop ( ? ) using Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( ? ) validate ProAS as a versatile, plug-and-play enhancer. It universally elevates mainstream group-based RL baselines (GRPO ( ? ), DAPO ( ? ), GiGPO ( ? )), boosting success rates by up to 16.7 points (e.g., GRPO on 1.5B ALFWorld) and accelerating training convergence by 1.12 × 1.12\times to 2.44 × 2.44\times . On top of that, this orthogonal enhancement propels these standard algorithms to establish new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, consistently eclipsing the strong segment-level baseline, MiGPO ( ? ). Notably, GiGPO+ProAS outperforms MiGPO by a massive 13.1 points on WebShop with 1.5B model and secures the highest overall success rate of 94.3% on ALFWorld with 7B model. Furthermore, comprehensive ablations (§ 6.2 ) show that ProAS’s core mechanisms are both synergistic and superior to alternative advantage shaping variants, and confirm ProAS’s robust efficacy against incomplete or distilled ARGs, underscoring the necessity of ARG’s online evolution mechanism.

Guided by a dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph (ARG), ProAS achieves fine-grained, critic-free credit assignment via Masking Unreasonable Incentives (MUI) and Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution (APR).

paragraphs.en: Multi-Turn Agentic Tasks. Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed to solve complex real-world tasks ( ? ). Given the intricacies of these environments, agents must engage in multi-turn interactions, continuously accumulating contextual knowledge and making sequential decisions to drive task completion. To facilitate the training and evaluation of such agents, the community has introduced various simulated environments. Examples include ALFWorld ( ? ) for embodied household tasks, WebShop ( ? ) for web navigation, AppWorld ( ? ) for application development, and τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench ( ? ) for evaluating dynamic conversational abilities in domains like aviation and retail.

paragraphs.en: Since RL fundamentally optimizes policies by incentivizing or suppressing action likelihoods, tailored credit assignment requires understanding both the intrinsic properties of each step (e.g., reasonableness and progress advancement) and how modulating them dictates the final outcome. To quantify these step-level properties, § 4.1 constructs an Agentic Reference Graph (ARG). Guided by an intervention study probing these modulation effects (§ 4.2 ), § 4.3 introduces Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping (ProAS), a lightweight framework designed to resolve the uniform credit dilemma via asymmetric advantage shaping.
paragraphs.zh: 由于强化学习（RL）本质上通过激励或抑制动作发生的可能性来优化策略，因此定制化的信用分配需要理解每一步的内在特性（例如合理性和进展推进），以及调节这些特性如何决定最终结果。 为了量化这些步骤层面的特性，第 4.1 节构建了一个智能体参考图（ARG）。 在第 4.2 节通过干预研究探究了这些调节效应的基础上，第 4.3 节引入了“进展感知优势塑造”（ProAS）——一个轻量级框架，旨在通过非对称的优势塑造来解决均匀信用分配难题。

paragraphs.en: Probing Unreasonable Actions. Unreasonable actions hinder task progress by polluting the context history and disrupting subsequent decisions ( ? ). Notably, they constitute a substantial proportion of successful GRPO trajectories (41.6% in ALFWorld, 39.6% in WebShop) of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, where they are inadvertently reinforced by the uniform credit applied to preferred rollouts. To probe their impact, we select a clean ALFWorld trajectory (details in Appx. D.1 ) and sample 50 continuations, { c i } i = 1 50 \{c_{i}\}_{i=1}^{50} , from a fixed state under two context conditions. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (b), the clean control retains the original history, whereas the noise-injected condition prepends a four-step unreasonable segment. Despite sharing the identical underlying environment state, this visible context noise degrades the Expected Success Rate (ESR) from 82% to 58%.
paragraphs.zh: 探究不合理行为。不合理行为通过污染上下文历史并干扰后续决策，阻碍任务进展（？）。值得注意的是，这类行为在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 成功完成 GRPO 轨迹中占据了相当大比例（ALFWorld 中为 41.6%，WebShop 中为 39.6%），而偏好 rollout 所采用的均匀信用分配机制无意中强化了这些行为。为了探究其影响，我们选择了一条干净的 ALFWorld 轨迹（详见附录 D.1），并在两种上下文条件下，从一个固定状态中采样了 50 个后续序列 { c i } i = 1 50 \{c_{i}\}_{i=1}^{50}。如图 1 (b) 所示，干净对照组保留了原始历史，而注入噪声的条件则在历史前添加了一个四步的不合理片段。尽管两者共享完全相同的基础环境状态，但这种显而易见的上下文噪声却将预期成功率（ESR）从 82% 降低到了 58%。

paragraphs.en: Baseline Comparisons. We first contrast ProAS against established learning paradigms. Although ProAS leverages annotated prior knowledge for ARG initialization, it significantly outperforms SFT, a direct strategy for utilizing such annotations. Specifically, GiGPO+ProAS surpasses SFT by 12.2 points on the 1.5B ALFWorld benchmark, demonstrating the superiority of active exploration over passive behavior cloning. Furthermore, PPO, a traditional RL algorithm featuring fine-grained credit assignment, exhibits massive variance across different random seeds in long-horizon settings, yielding a highly fluctuating 36.5 % ± 28.7 % 36.5\%\pm 28.7\% SR on 1.5B ALFWorld. This instability likely stems from the high sensitivity of critic training to variations in the training data. In contrast, other critic-free methods, such as GRPO, DAPO, and GiGPO, maintain controllable variance while simultaneously achieving superior performance.

paragraphs.en: Distill tests ProAS with synthetic references, since gold-standard trajectories are often unavailable in practice. We prompt a 7B model to generate successful rollouts across training tasks, building a distilled ARG covering 2,566 tasks. paragraphs.en: In this work, we expose the uniform credit assignment dilemma in critic-free agentic RL, where uniform advantages reinforce contextual noise in preferred trajectories ( A i > 0 A_{i}>0 ) and ignore the cascading influence of actions in unpreferred ones ( A i < 0 A_{i}<0 ). To address this without critic overhead, we proposed Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping (ProAS), which leverages a dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph (ARG) to achieve fine-grained credit assignment via Masking Unreasonable Incentives (MUI) and Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution (APR). Extensive evaluations across multiple model scales and environments confirm ProAS as a robust, universal enhancer that accelerates convergence and propels mainstream baselines to new state-of-the-art performance. The ablation study further confirms MUI-APR synergy, necessity of ARG evolution and robustness under incomplete or distilled ARGs. Together, these results establish a highly efficient, scalable pathway for elevating autonomous language agents.

paragraphs.en: Training Configuration. We perform full-parameter fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with the SFT trainer based on FSDP in Verl-Agent, minimizing the token-level negative log-likelihood of the oracle responses. We train for 3 epochs with AdamW ( β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 ), a peak learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , weight decay of 0.01 0.01 , and gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 . The learning rate follows a cosine schedule with a 3 % 3\% warmup. We use a maximum sequence length of 4,096 tokens with left truncation and per-GPU micro-batch sizes of 4 and 2 for the 1.5B and 7B models, respectively. We save the checkpoint at the end of each epoch and evaluate every epoch checkpoint on the same frozen 128-task validation set used for RL. The SFT result is reported from the checkpoint with the highest validation success rate.
paragraphs.zh: 训练配置。 我们使用基于 FSDP 的 SFT 训练器在 Verl-Agent 中对 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 进行全参数微调，以最小化 oracle 响应的词元级负对数似然。 我们使用 AdamW（β₁=0.9、β₂=0.95）进行 3 个周期的训练，峰值学习率为 10⁻⁵，权重衰减为 0.01，梯度裁剪阈值为 1.0。 学习率遵循余弦调度策略，并设置 3% 的预热阶段。 我们使用最大序列长度为 4,096 个词元，并采用左截断方式；对于 1.5B 和 7B 模型，每个 GPU 的微批次大小分别为 4 和 2。 我们在每个周期结束时保存检查点，并在每个周期对检查点使用与强化学习相同的冻结 128 任务验证集进行评估。 SFT 结果基于验证成功率为最高的检查点报告。

paragraphs.en: ALFWorld ( ? ) is a text-based embodied benchmark built from household tasks in simulated indoor scenes. It covers six task families: single-object manipulation (Pick) , object examination (Look) , cleaning (Clean) , heating (Heat) , cooling (Cool) , and two-object manipulation (Pick2) . paragraphs.en: We compare two visible-history conditions while fixing the underlying environment state and rollout budget. Both conditions replay the same three-action clean prefix and reach the same continuation point: the agent is at desk 1 , holding keychain 2 , with 47 steps remaining. From this state, we independently sample 50 continuations { c i } i = 1 50 \{c_{i}\}_{i=1}^{50} under each condition. In the noise-injected condition, four unreasonable actions are prepended only to the policy-visible interaction history; they are not executed in the continuation environment and therefore do not alter its starting state.

paragraphs.en: Table 9 illustrates the online ARG evolution mechanism using the task Look at a pencil under the desk lamp . Because the environment’s success criterion broadly accepts any pencil index (e.g., pencil 1 or pencil 2 ), the task inherently possesses multiple valid solutions that a single static ARG fails to cover. To capture this diversity, any rollout verified as successful during training is first purified by pruning invalid and inadmissible steps. The retained valid path is then seamlessly merged into the current ARG, dynamically expanding its coverage of viable solution trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 表9展示了在线ARG演化机制，该机制以“在台灯下观察一支铅笔”这一任务为例。 由于环境的成功标准广泛接受任何铅笔索引（例如铅笔1或铅笔2），因此该任务本质上存在多个有效解，而单个静态ARG无法覆盖这些解。 为了捕捉这种多样性，训练期间被验证为成功的任何展开过程，首先会通过剪枝去除无效和不可行的步骤进行净化。 随后，保留下来的有效路径将被无缝合并到当前的ARG中，从而动态扩展其对可行解轨迹的覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: The contrast highlights the intended granularity of action annotations deriving from ARG. Trajectories A and B differ only within g 3 \textbf{g}_{3} : they visit different intermediate option states but reach the same completion-state equivalence class, so both option orders are treated as progress-advancing. Trajectory C shows the complementary cases: a wrong option and a premature purchase are unsupported by the ARG, whereas a repeated click on an already selected option can be reasonable but non-advancing. Thus, the ARG preserves ordering constraints among high-level sub-goals while avoiding spurious penalties for valid option permutations.
paragraphs.zh: 这种对比凸显了源自 ARG 的动作标注所预期的粒度。 轨迹 A 和 B 仅在 g 3 \textbf{g}_{3} 内部存在差异：它们访问了不同的中间选项状态，但最终到达了相同的完成状态等价类，因此这两种选项顺序都被视为推进进展的。 轨迹 C 展示了相反的情况：错误的选项和过早的购买行为并未得到 ARG 的支持，而对已选选项的重复点击虽然可能合理，但不会推动进展。 因此，ARG 在保持高层子目标之间的顺序约束的同时，也避免了因有效的选项排列而产生的虚假惩罚。
